run_tips_inference: run TIPS or TIPSv2 inference on an image with text prompts via CLI arguments
run_tips_variant: run TIPSv2 inference with variant tips_v2_b14 and custom checkpoint directory
run_tips_highres: run TIPSv1 inference with variant tips_oss_b14_highres_distilled on a sample image
run_tips_custom_width: run TIPS inference with custom image width of 512 pixels for higher resolution
run_tips_text_similarity: run TIPS inference to compute cosine similarity between image and text embeddings
